name: Ashita no Nanami to Au Tame ni ~Ashita no Kimi to Au Tame ni~ Fandisc
original_name: 明日の七海と逢うために〜明日の君と逢うために〜FAN DISC
source:
One day, Shuji meets a girl in the music classroom. He doesn't know her, but she is Mina's younger sister, Manami. From that day, Shuji, Mina, and Manami's strange relationship begins....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081029050204/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011397]Eroge Shop[/url]]
